task_title: AUG-133: the published XSD is loaded, expressible and falsifiable — a real processor loads it, every attribute the code reads is declared, <test> is a usable block, and a processor-rejected dialect fails the run (fix 4481afb, graded at the current merged head)
task_criteria: Board AC1 (first half): a conforming XSD 1.0 processor loads specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd with no exception, and the shipped conformance suite for that schema passes in full. lxml 6.1.3 is the processor on this host. FAILIF: XMLSchemaParseError, or a passed count other than 12. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from lxml import etree; etree.XMLSchema(etree.parse(sys.argv[1]))" specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd && echo xsd_load_rc=0; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py

Board AC1 (second half): a fixture that is well-formed and code-acceptable but SCHEMA-INVALID is refused by BOTH CLI verbs with the typed schema-invalid error naming the file, line and attribute, while the accepted authored corpus still validates rc 0. FAILIF: either verb returns 0 on the invalid fixture, the refusal is not typed schema-invalid, or the control corpus does not return 0. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate tests/fixtures/xml/invalid/schema-invalid; echo validate_rc=$?; .venv/bin/python auger.py spec check tests/fixtures/xml/invalid/schema-invalid; echo check_rc=$?; .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate specs; echo control_rc=$?

Board AC2: the attribute inventory cannot drift again — it is DERIVED from auger.py AST attribute reads and compared with the XSD declarations, and every named obligation attribute (runner, selector, path, migration, fixture, assertions, type) is read by the code and declared on the schema block type. FAILIF: the test fails, or the AST scan is narrowed. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py -k every_attribute_the_code_reads

Board AC2 (grammar side): the seven obligation attributes the code reads are literally declared in the shipped XSD, so an editor validating a real obligation document does not flag it invalid. FAILIF: the unique declared count is not 7. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -oE "<xs:attribute name=\"(runner|selector|path|migration|fixture|assertions|type)\"" specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd | sort -u | wc -l

Board AC3: the <test> element is declared in the XSD and joins the block substitution group (so it can appear where blocks appear), the blockKind enum admits the test kind, and a corpus that actually USES a <test> block validates — a declaration no corpus can use would be the decorative schema again. FAILIF: no <test> element, wrong substitutionGroup, or the test fails. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c "xs:element name=\"test\" type=\"auger:blockType\" substitutionGroup=\"auger:block\"" specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py -k corpus_with_a_test_block

Board AC4: a schema file the processor REJECTS fails the run rather than reporting green — the in-suite mutation arm rewrites a facet into a dialect XSD 1.0 cannot express and demands a typed refusal, and the PRE-FIX schema at cf5bfe2 (which used the non-capturing group) is rejected by the same processor, so the loading arm is non-vacuous. FAILIF: the pre-fix schema loads with rc 0, or the mutation test fails. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && git show cf5bfe2:specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd > /tmp/aug133-prefix.xsd && .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from lxml import etree; etree.XMLSchema(etree.parse(sys.argv[1]))" /tmp/aug133-prefix.xsd; echo prefix_load_rc=$?; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py -k processor_rejected_pattern_dialect

The proof cannot silently leave the gate and it grades the landed fix: tests/gate.sh names tests/test_xsd_conformance.py twice (comment + pytest arm), the arm-pinning test passes, and the implementation commit 4481afb is an ancestor of the judged HEAD. FAILIF: the file is absent from the arm, the pinning test fails, or the ancestry check exits non-zero. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c "tests/test_xsd_conformance.py" tests/gate.sh; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py -k gate_arm_runs_this_file; git merge-base --is-ancestor 4481afb HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$?
